examples.title: Quilt Area Calculation
examples.problem: A quilt has 8 patches in each row and there are 6 rows. How many patches in total?
examples.explanation: Multiplying patches per row by number of rows gives the total count (Area).

examples.title: Tiling Logic
examples.solution: Because their corners (angles) are 90 degrees, and four such corners meet to form 360 degrees, leaving no space.
examples.explanation: For shapes to tile, the angles meeting at a point must sum up to 360 degrees.

examples.title: Estimating Area
examples.problem: A floor is covered by 10 full tiles and 4 half tiles. What is the total area in 'tile units'?
examples.explanation: Two half-tiles combined equal one full tile.
